step1_analysis.description: A CMOS common-source amplifier stage with active load, alongside multiple current mirrors and bias branches. It is likely part of the delta-sigma ADC integrator and bandgap reference mentioned in the paper.

paper_reference.title: A 1.8-V Delta-Sigma Modulator Interface for an Electret Microphone With On-Chip Reference

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of currents from VDD and N3 * 1.8V. With 0.9V bias, total current is approx 600uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on sky130 square law models with 0.9V bias on all current sources.

dc_gain.description: Low frequency open-loop voltage gain of the amplifier stage (N4 to N0)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. gm ≈ 800uS, Rout ≈ 58kOhm. Gain ≈ 46 V/V = 33 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single stage common-source amplifier with active load typically yields 20-40 dB gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cload). With 1pF load, BW ≈ 2.75 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by output resistance and parasitic/load capacitance. Easily exceeds the 11kHz audio requirement.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated via Fourier analysis with 1mV input.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small signal input (1mV) should yield very low distortion in open-loop.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient THD of the amplifier stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Amplifier/Bias Circuit
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xmb=5u L_xmb=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N15 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VBG N5 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N13 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N14 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XMB N0 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmb} w={W_xmb}
XM7 N10 N15 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 N6 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 1.8

* Bias Voltages
V8 N8 0 0.9
V15 N15 0 0.9
V5 N5 0 0.9
V13 N13 0 0.9
V14 N14 0 0.9

* Dummy Loads for current outputs
V1 N1 0 0.9
V10 N10 0 0.9
VVBG VBG 0 0.9

* Self-Biasing Feedback for Amplifier (XMB & XM5)
Lbias N0 N4 1000H
Cin in N4 1F
Cload N0 0 1p

* Input Signal
Vin in 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.001 11k)

* Models
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Analysis
.control
  op
  let power = -(i(VVDD) + i(VN3)) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1 100Meg
  let gain_db = vdb(n0)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac bw when gain_db='dc_gain-3' fall=1

  tran 1u 500u
  meas tran vout_max max v(n0)
  meas tran vout_min min v(n0)
  meas tran vout_pp param='vout_max-vout_min'
  fourier 11k v(n0)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
